name: CMOS switched-capacitor half divider
description: Four transmission gates place a 1 nF flying capacitor in series with the output during p1 and in parallel during p2. Two CMOS inverters generate phase complements: twelve MOS devices are explicit. With non-overlapping 1 MHz clocks, a 5 nF output capacitor and 1 Mohm load, the circuit approaches VIN/2. The experiment checks both 3.3 V and 2.8 V inputs, settled output levels and ripple after an input step. Two 1 Gohm resistors model flying-node leakage. Use the saved non-overlap timing. Educational nominal models; power-converter efficiency, high-current capability and PVT ratings are not qualified.
